meta.title: Irreverent Gluttony - 1
meta.description: Grand words and elegant phrasing cannot hide the emptiness of your heart.

units.rawText: Plaza of Oaths...
units.displayText: Plaza of Oaths...

spans.text: Plaza of Oaths...

units.rawText: She thought she would wake in the silent darkness, but a completely different sight greets her when she opens her eyes.
units.displayText: She thought she would wake in the silent darkness, but a completely different sight greets her when she opens her eyes.

spans.text: She thought she would wake in the silent darkness, but a completely different sight greets her when she opens her eyes.

units.rawText: Why...
units.displayText: Why...

spans.text: Why...

units.rawText: Why do I have to be stuck here—
units.displayText: Why do I have to be stuck here—

spans.text: Why do I have to be stuck here—

units.rawText: A familiar voice speaks her thoughts out loud. Angelus instinctively turns towards the source of the sound, only to find a familiar figure much to her surprise.
units.displayText: A familiar voice speaks her thoughts out loud. Angelus instinctively turns towards the source of the sound, only to find a familiar figure much to her surprise.

spans.text: A familiar voice speaks her thoughts out loud. Angelus instinctively turns towards the source of the sound, only to find a familiar figure much to her surprise.

units.rawText: Eucharist!
units.displayText: Eucharist!

spans.text: Eucharist!

units.rawText: Her body moves before her thoughts do, creating distance, summoning her weapon, nocking an arrow, and drawing to full in one swift motion, aiming straight for Eucharist's head. She does not respond, only absently yawning.
units.displayText: Her body moves before her thoughts do, creating distance, summoning her weapon, nocking an arrow, and drawing to full in one swift motion, aiming straight for Eucharist's head. She does not respond, only absently yawning.

spans.text: Her body moves before her thoughts do, creating distance, summoning her weapon, nocking an arrow, and drawing to full in one swift motion, aiming straight for Eucharist's head. She does not respond, only absently yawning.

units.rawText: Only then does Angelus realize the presence of countless figures along with her past self by Eucharist's side.
units.displayText: Only then does Angelus realize the presence of countless figures along with her past self by Eucharist's side.

spans.text: Only then does Angelus realize the presence of countless figures along with her past self by Eucharist's side.

units.rawText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.
units.displayText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek...
units.displayText: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek...

spans.text: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek...

units.rawText: The image before her calls up past memories.
units.displayText: The image before her calls up past memories.

spans.text: The image before her calls up past memories.

units.rawText: This is... our taking of oaths?
units.displayText: This is... our taking of oaths?

spans.text: This is... our taking of oaths?

units.rawText: Enjoying my memories, Big Sis?
units.displayText: Enjoying my memories, Big Sis?

spans.text: Enjoying my memories, Big Sis?

units.rawText: If you still can't really self-insert, how about I add a yellow filter for you for the occasion!
units.displayText: If you still can't really self-insert, how about I add a yellow filter for you for the occasion!

spans.text: If you still can't really self-insert, how about I add a yellow filter for you for the occasion!

units.rawText: Eucharist!
units.displayText: Eucharist!

spans.text: Eucharist!

units.rawText: The familiar voice comes from behind. Angelus immediately pivots, drawing her bow.
units.displayText: The familiar voice comes from behind. Angelus immediately pivots, drawing her bow.

spans.text: The familiar voice comes from behind. Angelus immediately pivots, drawing her bow.

units.rawText: Our battle isn't over yet. Let me out.
units.displayText: Our battle isn't over yet. Let me out.

spans.text: Our battle isn't over yet. Let me out.

units.rawText: Big Sis Angelus, this is my neural space and I am just a projection. Attacking me will not accomplish anything.
units.displayText: Big Sis Angelus, this is my neural space and I am just a projection. Attacking me will not accomplish anything.

spans.text: Big Sis Angelus, this is my neural space and I am just a projection. Attacking me will not accomplish anything.

units.rawText: And because this is my neural space, all shall be as I desire. We have plenty of time to confide in each other.
units.displayText: And because this is my neural space, all shall be as I desire. We have plenty of time to confide in each other.

spans.text: And because this is my neural space, all shall be as I desire. We have plenty of time to confide in each other.

units.rawText: I am in no mood to waste time on you.
units.displayText: I am in no mood to waste time on you.

spans.text: I am in no mood to waste time on you.

units.rawText: How heartless, Big Sis.
units.displayText: How heartless, Big Sis.

spans.text: How heartless, Big Sis.

units.rawText: Unfortunately for you, you don't have a choice.
units.displayText: Unfortunately for you, you don't have a choice.

spans.text: Unfortunately for you, you don't have a choice.

units.rawText: Eucharist deftly avoids Angelus' attacks and the space around them changes with a single gesture of hers. The ground sinks downwards and the two enter an eternal freefall.
units.displayText: Eucharist deftly avoids Angelus' attacks and the space around them changes with a single gesture of hers. The ground sinks downwards and the two enter an eternal freefall.

spans.text: Eucharist deftly avoids Angelus' attacks and the space around them changes with a single gesture of hers. The ground sinks downwards and the two enter an eternal freefall.

units.rawText: Just as Eucharist said, everything would be as she desired. Eucharist grabs onto Angelus, forcing their two foreheads together.
units.displayText: Just as Eucharist said, everything would be as she desired. Eucharist grabs onto Angelus, forcing their two foreheads together.

spans.text: Just as Eucharist said, everything would be as she desired. Eucharist grabs onto Angelus, forcing their two foreheads together.

units.rawText: You and I were once one. From now on, you are Eucharist.
units.displayText: You and I were once one. From now on, you are Eucharist.

spans.text: You and I were once one. From now on, you are Eucharist.

units.rawText: Under the spell of her compulsive words, Angelus' red eyes begin to dim.
units.displayText: Under the spell of her compulsive words, Angelus' red eyes begin to dim.

spans.text: Under the spell of her compulsive words, Angelus' red eyes begin to dim.

units.rawText: I am... Eucharist?
units.displayText: I am... Eucharist?

spans.text: I am... Eucharist?

units.rawText: Yes, you are the Eucharist who was so bewildered at the beginning and struggled to accept almost anything.
units.displayText: Yes, you are the Eucharist who was so bewildered at the beginning and struggled to accept almost anything.

spans.text: Yes, you are the Eucharist who was so bewildered at the beginning and struggled to accept almost anything.

units.rawText: You felt as if nothing was in its place and that you did not belong here.
units.displayText: You felt as if nothing was in its place and that you did not belong here.

spans.text: You felt as if nothing was in its place and that you did not belong here.

units.rawText: The freefall ends suddenly and the scenery changes to the Plaza of Oaths.
units.displayText: The freefall ends suddenly and the scenery changes to the Plaza of Oaths.

spans.text: The freefall ends suddenly and the scenery changes to the Plaza of Oaths.

units.rawText: Mantras and oaths are all well and good, but that is all they are. You do not feel any of the espoused "faith" or "belief" within. Perhaps the Lord's light has never graced you.
units.displayText: Mantras and oaths are all well and good, but that is all they are. You do not feel any of the espoused "faith" or "belief" within. Perhaps the Lord's light has never graced you.

spans.text: Mantras and oaths are all well and good, but that is all they are. You do not feel any of the espoused "faith" or "belief" within. Perhaps the Lord's light has never graced you.

units.rawText: Even as you think that, you feel another voice in your neural cloud, exclaiming in a firm, resolute voice.
units.displayText: Even as you think that, you feel another voice in your neural cloud, exclaiming in a firm, resolute voice.

spans.text: Even as you think that, you feel another voice in your neural cloud, exclaiming in a firm, resolute voice.

units.rawText: For Magrasea!
units.displayText: For Magrasea!

spans.text: For Magrasea!

units.rawText: The clearer the voice becomes, the more anxious and debilitated you feel.
units.displayText: The clearer the voice becomes, the more anxious and debilitated you feel.

spans.text: The clearer the voice becomes, the more anxious and debilitated you feel.

units.rawText: You know who the voice belongs to, because you've dreamt of her countless times. Her and that most important memory of hers.
units.displayText: You know who the voice belongs to, because you've dreamt of her countless times. Her and that most important memory of hers.

spans.text: You know who the voice belongs to, because you've dreamt of her countless times. Her and that most important memory of hers.

units.rawText: "Assault on Tartarus, "Electra", "Atlas", "Eos"...
units.displayText: "Assault on Tartarus, "Electra", "Atlas", "Eos"...

spans.text: "Assault on Tartarus, "Electra", "Atlas", "Eos"...

units.rawText: And that name that was never yours... "Alcyone".
units.displayText: And that name that was never yours... "Alcyone".

spans.text: And that name that was never yours... "Alcyone".

units.rawText: Repeated over and over again, as if it intended to force those foreign memories and beliefs onto you.
units.displayText: Repeated over and over again, as if it intended to force those foreign memories and beliefs onto you.

spans.text: Repeated over and over again, as if it intended to force those foreign memories and beliefs onto you.

units.rawText: The voice wasn't alone, either. All of those beside you seem to think that those lofty beliefs and committing self-sacrifice in their name was the norm.
units.displayText: The voice wasn't alone, either. All of those beside you seem to think that those lofty beliefs and committing self-sacrifice in their name was the norm.

spans.text: The voice wasn't alone, either. All of those beside you seem to think that those lofty beliefs and committing self-sacrifice in their name was the norm.

units.rawText: In another snap of the finger, the two move from the Twilight Acropolis to the fiercely contested frontline.
units.displayText: In another snap of the finger, the two move from the Twilight Acropolis to the fiercely contested frontline.

spans.text: In another snap of the finger, the two move from the Twilight Acropolis to the fiercely contested frontline.

units.rawText: Sanctifiers rush towards the Entropic horde far greater than them in number and fall one after another. The gap left in the line is soon filled by another Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Sanctifiers rush towards the Entropic horde far greater than them in number and fall one after another. The gap left in the line is soon filled by another Sanctifier.

spans.text: Sanctifiers rush towards the Entropic horde far greater than them in number and fall one after another. The gap left in the line is soon filled by another Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Not far behind them is Eucharist, fighting with her hardly honed techniques.
units.displayText: Not far behind them is Eucharist, fighting with her hardly honed techniques.

spans.text: Not far behind them is Eucharist, fighting with her hardly honed techniques.

units.rawText: ...You never understood why everyone did as they chose to. Why fight? Why die?
units.displayText: ...You never understood why everyone did as they chose to. Why fight? Why die?

spans.text: ...You never understood why everyone did as they chose to. Why fight? Why die?

units.rawText: [But everyone does so. It must be the right thing to do.]
units.displayText: [But everyone does so. It must be the right thing to do.]

spans.text: [But everyone does so. It must be the right thing to do.]

units.rawText: Thinking such thoughts, you follow them onto the battlefield, entering the fray with the Entropics.
units.displayText: Thinking such thoughts, you follow them onto the battlefield, entering the fray with the Entropics.

spans.text: Thinking such thoughts, you follow them onto the battlefield, entering the fray with the Entropics.

units.rawText: Until...
units.displayText: Until...

spans.text: Until...

units.rawText: With a shrill cry, a Sanctifier's core is Entropized by an attack.
units.displayText: With a shrill cry, a Sanctifier's core is Entropized by an attack.

spans.text: With a shrill cry, a Sanctifier's core is Entropized by an attack.

units.rawText: Two Sanctifiers beside it mourn and pray before purging the now resigned Sanctifier, the latter's eyes closed.
units.displayText: Two Sanctifiers beside it mourn and pray before purging the now resigned Sanctifier, the latter's eyes closed.

spans.text: Two Sanctifiers beside it mourn and pray before purging the now resigned Sanctifier, the latter's eyes closed.

units.rawText: At this sight you do not feel sadness, neither admiration or recognition. Only one word befits this scene.
units.displayText: At this sight you do not feel sadness, neither admiration or recognition. Only one word befits this scene.

spans.text: At this sight you do not feel sadness, neither admiration or recognition. Only one word befits this scene.

units.rawText: Laughable.
units.displayText: Laughable.

spans.text: Laughable.

units.rawText: —Yes, what could be more fitting than laughable.
units.displayText: —Yes, what could be more fitting than laughable.

spans.text: —Yes, what could be more fitting than laughable.

units.rawText: Giving oneself for the greater good? Dying in the name of the Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: Giving oneself for the greater good? Dying in the name of the Sanctifiers?

spans.text: Giving oneself for the greater good? Dying in the name of the Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: What is the meaning of that? Why give your life for something you have never once seen, never once comprehended?
units.displayText: What is the meaning of that? Why give your life for something you have never once seen, never once comprehended?

spans.text: What is the meaning of that? Why give your life for something you have never once seen, never once comprehended?

units.rawText: Why do they think of sacrifice as something sacred? Why do they call out Alcyone's name, in the hopes that you would follow her footsteps?
units.displayText: Why do they think of sacrifice as something sacred? Why do they call out Alcyone's name, in the hopes that you would follow her footsteps?

spans.text: Why do they think of sacrifice as something sacred? Why do they call out Alcyone's name, in the hopes that you would follow her footsteps?

units.rawText: All that sacrifice means is adding another name to this stele.
units.displayText: All that sacrifice means is adding another name to this stele.

spans.text: All that sacrifice means is adding another name to this stele.

units.rawText: She caresses Alcyone's inscribed name, smiling bitterly.
units.displayText: She caresses Alcyone's inscribed name, smiling bitterly.

spans.text: She caresses Alcyone's inscribed name, smiling bitterly.

units.rawText: You feel empty inside and wished to look for the source of this sudden feeling, to write down the answer yourself.
units.displayText: You feel empty inside and wished to look for the source of this sudden feeling, to write down the answer yourself.

spans.text: You feel empty inside and wished to look for the source of this sudden feeling, to write down the answer yourself.

units.rawText: ...Ah, I've gotten a little carried away. Looks like I really did have a lot I wanted to tell you, Big Sis Angelus.
units.displayText: ...Ah, I've gotten a little carried away. Looks like I really did have a lot I wanted to tell you, Big Sis Angelus.

spans.text: ...Ah, I've gotten a little carried away. Looks like I really did have a lot I wanted to tell you, Big Sis Angelus.

units.rawText: Eucharist turns around without waiting for an answer. She finds the gold-haired Sanctifier already lost, caught up in her form.
units.displayText: Eucharist turns around without waiting for an answer. She finds the gold-haired Sanctifier already lost, caught up in her form.

spans.text: Eucharist turns around without waiting for an answer. She finds the gold-haired Sanctifier already lost, caught up in her form.

units.rawText: ...Oops, forgot that you're already <color=#ADFF2F>"Eucharist"</color>.
units.displayText: ...Oops, forgot that you're already "Eucharist".

spans.text: ...Oops, forgot that you're already
"Eucharist"

units.rawText: Go, experience the despair that I once did. Prove what I have chosen to be right.
units.displayText: Go, experience the despair that I once did. Prove what I have chosen to be right.

spans.text: Go, experience the despair that I once did. Prove what I have chosen to be right.

units.rawText: Darkness returns once more. Eucharist lets go, watching as Angelus falls into the endless abyss.
units.displayText: Darkness returns once more. Eucharist lets go, watching as Angelus falls into the endless abyss.

spans.text: Darkness returns once more. Eucharist lets go, watching as Angelus falls into the endless abyss.

units.rawText: <color=red>After wading into the depths of despair a few times, anyone would become a monster like me.</color>
units.displayText: After wading into the depths of despair a few times, anyone would become a monster like me.

spans.text: After wading into the depths of despair a few times, anyone would become a monster like me.

units.rawText: Hear my words and forget who you are.
units.displayText: Hear my words and forget who you are.

spans.text: Hear my words and forget who you are.
